title: Back to the Beach
meta_description: This cozy 3BR retreat features a screened porch, golf cart, bikes \& access to a resort-style pool nearby! All this and more at Back to the Beach!
description_expanded:
Blue Sky, Sandy Sand Below, Peace Within This Beach! Back To the Beach We Go....

ABOUT THIS HOME: This quaint coastal home, located in the Highland Park neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach, is the perfect place for intimate family gatherings. Back to the Beach is a 3 bedroom home that comfortably sleeps 8. With it's open concept designed space, you're never to far from the action, unless you want to be and there's a perfect spot for that. The beautiful screened in porch has plenty of comfortable seating to sit back and relax with a glass of wine or cup of coffee. This house has everything you'll need to enjoy your next vacation by the sea.

ABOUT THE AREA: Back to The Beach is located in the Highland Parks Community. They have an amazing community pool that is only a bike ride away! You can also go for a bike ride or hike on the trail in your backyard. Take a stroll to one of the nearby restaurants, or pick up a pastry and coffee from Blue Mountain Bakery (their cinnamon rolls are out of this world).

BEACH ACCESS: Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access is just a short distance away. Hop on your bikes and get ready for an amazing day! When you make it out of your neighborhood take a left, continue on 30A for about a mile then take a right on to Blue Mountain Rd. At the stop sign turn right and you have made it to the beach.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 - 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 Queen, ensuite (shared)
• Bedroom 3 -- 1 Queen, ensuite (shared)
• Bunk Room -- 1 Twin/Twin Bunk

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 2 Bikes
• Grill -- Propane
• Community pool
• Screened in porch with couch
• Smart TVs
• Coffee Maker -- traditional
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Fully stocked kitchen

\*\*\* Includes 2 complimentary adult bikes and 6 seater golf cart \*\*\*\*

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please do not move any of the furniture in the home.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 3 parking spaces with no overflow parking.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
